title: Mysterious Dungeon Map
description: A top-down fantasy dungeon map rendered as an illustrated artwork. The complex stone layout includes a large circular chamber with an eye symbol and glowing teal orbs, glowing purple magical pools, green toxic water channels, statues in a purple ritual room, mechanical gears, and various connecting corridors with vines and glowing elements.
prompt: Top-down view of an intricate fantasy dungeon map with stone walls and pathways. Features a large circular chamber containing a central eye symbol surrounded by four glowing teal orbs, glowing purple magical pools, channels of green water, a room with multiple statues on pedestals, mechanical gears with a keyhole, and connecting corridors overgrown with vines, in a hand-painted fantasy illustration style on aged parchment.
